description: Feed cost per egg (pasza na jedno jajko, jaja): from the number of hens (kur), eggs per day (jaj dziennie), feed per hen and feed price returns the feed cost per egg and per month for the flock, and with the egg selling price what is left after feed. Missing values come from a standard and are listed in zalozenia. [Moduł wiedzy Moja Pasza, https://mojapasza.com; hub przekazuje pytanie do jego serwera]
